correctness.rationale: Write M=QA⊗I+I⊗QB, let [H0,M]=0. Exponential functional calculus gives e^{-(H0-hM)/T}=(KA⊗KB)e^{-H0/T}(KA⊗KB) for KA=e^{hQA/(2T)}, KB=e^{hQB/(2T)}. Partial transpose obeys (left/right local-filter) congruence with KA⊗KB^T, and positivity/invertibility at every finite h and T>0 permits Sylvester inertia. Full positive/zero/negative PT signature, including each zero-crossing temperature, is independent of h. XXZ flip-flop S1+S2−+S1−S2+ conserves total Sz. Exact finite 9-state rational checker inspected for PT entry identity and 8 allowed spin transitions; general proof does not depend on it.
